title: A Stationary Mean-Field Model for Carbon Market Stability Reserve
abstract: arXiv:2610.33132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We formulate the design of a market stability reserve as a stationary mean-field singular control problem. The allowance balance follows a regime-switching diffusion, while the regulator injects or withdraws allowances through bounded-variation controls. The objective trades off the average allowance balance, its stationary dispersion, deviations from a long-run target, and intervention costs. The optimal policy is a regime-dependent band rule characterized by four reflecting thresholds. Its computation reduces to a scalar fixed-point problem combining a coupled variational inequality with the invariant distribution of the reflected process. A calibration to the EU ETS yields thresholds of the same order of magnitude as the existing Market Stability Reserve rule. translated_title: 碳市场稳定储备的平稳平均场模型
translated_abstract: 我们将市场稳定储备的设计构建为一个平稳平均场奇异控制问题。配额余额遵循一个机制切换扩散过程，而监管者通过有界变差控制来注入或撤回配额。目标函数在平均配额余额、其平稳离散度、与长期目标的偏离以及干预成本之间进行权衡。最优政策是一个依赖机制状态的带状规则，由四个反射阈值刻画。其计算可归结为一个标量不动点问题，该问题结合了耦合变分不等式与反射过程的不变分布。对欧盟碳排放交易体系（EU ETS）的校准显示，所得阈值与现行市场稳定储备规则处于同一数量级。比较静态分析表明，波动性是干预区间的主要决定因素，而危机机制的频率和持续时间的影响则较为有限。
tldr: 该论文将碳市场稳定储备的设计建模为平稳平均场奇异控制问题，证明最优政策是由四个反射阈值刻画的机制依赖带状规则，对EU ETS的校准表明其阈值与现行规则处于同一数量级，且波动性是干预区间的主要决定因素。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates carbon market stability reserve design as a stationary mean-field singular control problem, proving the optimal policy is a regime-dependent band rule characterized by four reflecting thresholds, with EU ETS calibration yielding thresholds of the same magnitude as the existing rule and identifying volatility as the main determinant of the intervention band.
